title: Ron Hell: Maria is a natural Asian-African hybrid

tellings.quote: My hypothesis is that Maria is a hybrid but natural.

plain: Maria, one of the three-fingered bodies found in Peru that some call alien, is a hybrid, but a natural one, mixing Asian and African ancestry, according to a researcher named David Ron Hell. He tells Michels this is his own hypothesis: "My hypothesis is that Maria is a hybrid but natural," which would make her a strange human rather than something from elsewhere.
